Part 1 - Classes and Methods / ODWindowState

GetWindowCount

The GetWindowCount method returns the number of windows (of all open drafts) in this window-state object. 
ODUShort GetWindowCount ();
return value
The total number of windows in this window-state object, expressed as an unsigned 16-bit value.
